say:1:1430219101:1.text: It's my parents. They want me to marry the daughter of a great nobleman to improve our family's status and reputation.
say:1:1430219101:1.source_cn: 是我的父母，他们想让我娶一位大贵族的女儿，通过联姻来让...
say:1:1430219101:1.male: It's my parents. They want me to marry the daughter of a great nobleman to improve our family's status and reputation.
say:1:1430219101:1.female: It's my parents. They want me to marry the daughter of a great nobleman to improve our family's status and reputation.

say:2:1430219102:1.text: I love you, my dear, but my family is no great power in the royal city. I'm afraid your parents will force you to wed.
say:2:1430219102:1.source_cn: 我也爱你，可……我的家族在王城区太过普通，我担心他们会...

say:3:1430219103:1.text: Don't worry, my love. They can't force me to do something I don't want to do.
say:3:1430219103:1.source_cn: 放心吧，亲爱的。我不会向他们屈服的。
